news.headline: Abivax Named Among Three Top Immunology Takeover Targets in PharmaVoice Dealmaking Analysis
news.summary: PharmaVoice profiled Abivax alongside Spyre Therapeutics and MoonLake Immunotherapeutics as one of the immunology sector's most talked-about M&A candidates, citing the strong ABTECT maintenance data (37% clinical remission and 48% endoscopic improvement at Week 44 among induction non-responders on 50 mg) and a roughly $25bn addressable IBD market by 2030. It notes CEO Marc de Garidel dismissed earlier 2026 Eli Lilly acquisition rumors as 'noise,' and that the $920m July offering funds the company into 2029, reducing the urgency for a near-term sale.

news.headline: ABTECT Maintenance Part 2 Review: Obefazimod Sustains Week-44 Remission With No Dose-Dependent Malignancy Signal
news.summary: A detailed clinical review of the Phase 3 ABTECT Part 2 maintenance package confirmed that 37.2% of induction non-responders reached clinical remission and 34.5% endoscopic remission at Week 44 on continued 50 mg obefazimod, and that dose escalation to 50 mg recaptured clinical remission in 45.5% of patients who had relapsed in Part 1. Crucially for the June malignancy overhang, the expanded exposure showed malignancy and non-melanoma skin cancer rates consistent with UC background rates and no apparent dose-dependent signal.

news.headline: TCG Crossover and Chen Yu Report 7.0% Stake in Abivax After the July Offering
news.summary: Healthcare crossover investor TCG Crossover (Funds I and II, via managing partner Chen Yu) disclosed beneficial ownership of 6,007,834 ADSs, or 7.0% of Abivax, based on 86.09 million shares outstanding after the July 2, 2026 offering. It confirms that a dedicated biotech specialist held on through the large equity raise rather than selling into strength.

news.headline: Invus Entities Disclose 6.0% Beneficial Stake in Abivax
news.summary: Long-standing shareholder Invus (together with the Avicenna Fund) reported 4,825,759 ordinary shares and ADSs, equal to 6.0% of Abivax as of June 30, 2026. Alongside the TCG filing it rounds out an August picture of a stable, concentrated institutional register ahead of the NDA filing.

news.headline: Abivax Announces Positive Pre-NDA Interaction with the FDA for Obefazimod
news.summary: The FDA gave constructive feedback and aligned with Abivax on the planned submission strategy, content and format of the obefazimod NDA in moderately-to-severely active ulcerative colitis. Abivax confirmed it remains on track to file its first-ever NDA by the end of 2026, removing a key procedural uncertainty.

news.headline: Morgan Stanley Raises Abivax Price Target to $180 from $132, Maintains Overweight
news.summary: Morgan Stanley lifted its target well above the prevailing share price, citing growing confidence in the obefazimod UC data package and the NDA timeline after the maintenance results and pre-NDA FDA feedback. It sits at the top of a sell-side range whose consensus target stood at roughly $166 as of late August (Piper Sandler $175, Jefferies Buy at $158, Leerink $148).

catalysts.label: H1 2026 financial results
catalysts.detail: Abivax has this date fixed in its published financial calendar, now about three weeks out. The report will show the first post-raise balance sheet (cash was EUR 491.6m at March 31, 2026 before the $920m July offering, with runway now guided into 2029) and the step-up in R&D and pre-launch commercial spend. Expect a business update on NDA preparation and the U.S. commercial build-out alongside the numbers.

catalysts.label: Euronext Paris September quarterly review - possible CAC 40 promotion
catalysts.detail: Abivax has already been promoted twice by Euronext in 2026: into the CAC Mid 60/SBF 120 at the September 2025 annual review, then into the larger CAC Next 20 and CAC Large 60 at the June 2026 quarterly review (announced June 12, effective after close June 19, alongside Ipsen and Soitec). The next quarterly review is due around mid-September 2026; with a market capitalisation near EUR 8.5-10bn, a further step up into the flagship CAC 40 itself is plausible but not confirmed and would force additional passive/index-tracker buying.

catalysts.label: Full ABTECT maintenance dataset at a major gastroenterology congress
catalysts.detail: Abivax presented its ABTECT induction late-breaker at UEG Week in October 2025 and has a consistent pattern of taking full datasets to autumn congresses. A detailed public presentation of the Week-44 maintenance efficacy and, above all, the complete malignancy/safety database would be the cleanest way to fully retire the June cancer-signal overhang. Neither a venue nor an abstract acceptance for a 2026 autumn congress has been announced yet.

catalysts.label: NDA submission to FDA for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis
catalysts.detail: After positive Phase 3 ABTECT induction data, the 44-week maintenance readout, the Part 2 refractory-patient dataset and the constructive pre-NDA meeting on July 30, 2026, Abivax plans to submit its first NDA for obefazimod in moderately-to-severely active UC in late Q4 2026. This is the single biggest near-term de-risking event and the gate that starts the FDA review clock. Management has reiterated the timeline at every update this year.

catalysts.label: MAA submission to the EMA for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis
catalysts.detail: Abivax guided to filing a Marketing Authorization Application in Europe in the second half of 2026, contingent on the (now positive) 44-week maintenance data. Recent communication has emphasised the Q4 2026 FDA filing without restating a precise EMA date, so exact MAA timing remains unconfirmed and could slip into H1 2027.

catalysts.label: Phase 2b ENHANCE-CD Crohn's disease 12-week induction topline data
catalysts.detail: Topline results from the Phase 2b induction trial of obefazimod in moderately-to-severely active Crohn's disease are guided for mid-2027 (enrollment started Q3 2024). A positive readout opens a second large indication for the miR-124 mechanism and is the main pipeline diversification event, but it likely lands near or just after the March-2027 option expiry.

catalysts.label: Potential FDA approval decision and U.S. launch of obefazimod
catalysts.detail: With a Q4 2026 filing and a standard review cycle, an FDA decision would fall roughly 10-12 months later, i.e. in H2 2027 - after the March-2027 call expiry. No PDUFA date exists yet because the NDA has not been submitted. The commercial organisation being hired since July is being built against this window, making it the ultimate approval and revenue catalyst for the equity.

pulse: Abivax has traded in a narrow $110-$124 band since late August (last confirmed close $113.35 on August 28, versus $113.51 on August 31), holding its post-crash recovery with no fresh company news since the August 26 PharmaVoice piece naming it a top immunology takeover target. Fundamentally the story remains de-risked and now about execution: ABTECT induction plus Week-44 maintenance data are strong (about 51% remission vs 10% placebo, 37.2% of induction non-responders converted and 45.5% of relapsers recaptured on 50 mg), the Part 2 safety database shows malignancy rates in line with UC background rates, FDA alignment on the NDA is locked in for a late-Q4 2026 filing, and the $920m raise funds a solo U.S. launch into 2029 with a senior commercial team already hired. Sell-side consensus sits near $166 with Morgan Stanley at $180 and Jefferies back to Buy at $158; for the March-2027 $120 call the position is roughly at the money and the next real catalyst is the September 21 H1 report, followed by a likely autumn congress presentation of the full safety dataset, the NDA landing on time, and whether M&A speculation (Eli Lilly rumors the CEO has repeatedly downplayed) re-ignites before expiry.
